title: DoctorReport
description: The frozen envelope for pyforge-doctor (Story 1.1): one document per invocation, {schema_version, verb, generated_at, findings, prescriptions}. prescriptions is present (an array, possibly empty) ONLY when verb == 'diagnose'; for 'check'/'monitor' the key must be entirely absent (never null). grade/axis_scores (Story 4.1) are optional additive fields present only on a report the CLI actually computed a grade for (today: 'diagnose'). additionalProperties is deliberately left open on findings/prescriptions sub-objects: additive growth (a new evidence shape, new rank_factors keys) is never a schema break.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version; starts at 1 (carries warden's ComplianceReport precedent — schema-validated, versioned — forward).

verb.description: The CLI verb that produced this report.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the report was generated at.

grade.description: Story 4.1: composite health grade over this report's own findings; present only when the CLI computed one.

axis_scores.description: Story 4.1: per-Source axis breakdown backing 'grade'; present only alongside 'grade'.

evidence.description: Source-specific object, opaque to this envelope.

rank.description: Populated by a later epic's ranking pass; null until then.

rank_factors.description: Populated by a later epic's ranking pass; null until then.

safe_upgrade_target.description: Story 4.4: a single-hop next-safe-version recommendation; null when not confidently known (see safe_upgrade_reason).

safe_upgrade_reason.description: Story 4.4: always states why safe_upgrade_target is (or isn't) populated.
